51555269.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to human galectin-1 assessed as dissociation constant by SPR analysis

original_paragraph.SPR Analysis: To detect the affinity of 4c to human and mouse full-length galectin-1 and -3, SPR analysis was performed with BiAcore (Cytiva, USA) in the presence of 5% DMSO at 25 °C. The target protein was immobilized onto a CM3 sensor chip via amine coupling, and different concentrations of 4c were injected at a flow rate of 30 μL/min. SPR response was recorded as a function of time at 25 °C between proteins, and kon and koff were determined using global fitting parameters with a 1:1 binding model and Kd calculated from steady-state fitting; 4c binding to galectin was stable at 25 °C for the duration of the experiment.

original_paragraph.Figure 3 caption: Figure 3. Inhibition of galectin-1-induced Jurkat cell apoptosis measured by caspase activation at 16 h. Apoptosis was induced by 2 μM galectin-1 concanamer, with data shown as mean ± SEM of at least six separate experimental replicates. Compound 4c inhibited galectin-1-induced apoptosis of Jurkat cells with an IC50 value of 2.30 ± 0.61 μM (mean ± SEM, n = 6), while OTX008 demonstrated no ability to inhibit the apoptosis induced by galectin-1 over the compound concentration range tested (up to 24 μM (n = 10)).
